body: S170-22 was marked done based on go build/go test passing, but the live systemd service (fatbaby-newssite.service) was running a binary from 2026-07-19, five days before the company-bios code existed. Rebuilt bin/newssite, restarted the service, confirmed via log (company-bios loaded count=51) and a live curl of /ticker/AAPL. Lesson: code-done and deploy-done are different claims. BACKLOG S170-38.
title: Fix: company bios weren't actually live (stale binary)
